customer: Can someone come to my place to buy my pickup? I commute long hours and can't easily get to a location in Dunmore.
agent: Yes, per our Home pickup service article, a Northwind specialist can come to your home or office in every state we serve, inspect your truck, and complete the sale on the spot at no charge. They'll bring the paperwork and pay you by bank draft. Just book home pickup when you schedule your appraisal, have everything on the appointment checklist ready, and park the truck where it can be inspected in daylight.
